articles.title: Cisco Systems (CSCO) Tied To FAA Ground Stop After Router Failures Hit Flights
articles.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) equipment was cited in an FAA nationwide ground stop that disrupted US flights on 16 November 2026. Preliminary FAA updates linked the outage to router failures in core networking infrastructure that supports air traffic control systems. Federal regulators and aviation operators began reviewing Cisco infrastructure contracts and redundancy practices used in critical air travel operations.
